description.value: La Cucina is a small, family-style Italian restaurant on Saturna Island specializing in authentic Neapolitan pizzas and fresh pasta made with quality ingredients. It operates on a limited weekly schedule, making it one of the very few dining destinations on this quiet and lightly travelled Gulf Island. The warm, cozy atmosphere and reservation-based seating give it a distinctly local character that sets it apart from mainland dining stops.

address.value: 101 Narvaez Bay Road, Saturna Island, BC V0N 2Y0
